items.definition:
an earlier event or action that is regarded as an example or guide to be considered in subsequent similar circumstances
The judge's ruling set a legal precedent.

the consistent existence or operation of something over time
There was a lack of continuity in the film's plot.

a hard gray rock consisting of nearly pure silica
Early humans used flint to make tools and weapons.

the holder of an office or post
The incumbent president is seeking re-election.

a historical account or biography written from personal knowledge
She published a memoir about her time abroad.

a person's child or children; an animal's young
The lioness protected her offspring fiercely.

the action of forbidding something by law
There is a strict prohibition against smoking in this building.

the sacred writings of a religion
Many people find comfort in reading scripture.

an individual animal, plant, piece of a mineral, etc., used as an example of its species or type for scientific study or display
The scientist collected a rare plant specimen.

the ability to be maintained at a certain rate or level
Environmental sustainability is crucial for future generations.

a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change
Her speech was a catalyst for change in the community.

a chronic or persistent disorder of the mental processes caused by brain disease or injury
Her grandmother was diagnosed with dementia.

a derogatory term for a woman who has many sexual partners
Using derogatory terms like 'slut' is offensive and unacceptable.

blood that has been shed, especially as a result of violence
The movie was criticized for its excessive gore.

the act of assessing the value of something
The company's valuation increased significantly after the merger.

the action or process of distributing something
The allocation of resources was carefully planned.

official permission or approval
You need authorization to access this area.

a sum paid for killing or capturing a person or animal; a generous amount
The government offered a bounty for the capture of the escaped prisoner.

the body of all people ordained for religious duties
The local clergy attended the interfaith meeting.

the feeling that a person or a thing is beneath consideration, worthless, or deserving scorn
She felt nothing but contempt for his actions.

a qualification, achievement, personal quality, or aspect of a person's background, typically when used to indicate that they are suitable for something
His academic credentials made him a strong candidate for the job.

the action of spending or using money, time, or resources
The company needs to reduce its expenditures.

sexual attraction to people of the same sex
The discussion included topics like homosexuality and gender identity.

a mentally unstable person (informal)
He acted like a complete psycho during the argument.

close examination
The new policy came under close scrutiny.

a clear liquid part of blood
The doctor ordered a blood serum test.

financial aid
The government provides subsidies to farmers.

a rebellion
The government quickly suppressed the uprising.

excessive pride in one's appearance or achievements
His vanity was his biggest flaw.

the branch of technology and industry concerned with both aviation and spaceflight
The aerospace industry is constantly developing new technologies.

a natural electrical phenomenon characterized by light in the sky
We hoped to see the aurora borealis during our trip to Norway.

a member of a constituency; a component part of something
The senator met with her constituents to discuss local issues.

heated disagreement; an assertion, especially one maintained in argument
The main point of contention was the budget allocation.

an agreement; a contract
They signed a covenant to protect the historic building.

the territory ruled by an emir
Dubai is a well-known emirate in the UAE.

a principal taxonomic category that ranks above species and below family
Lions and tigers belong to the same genus, Panthera.

inflammation
The doctor said the swelling was due to inflammation.

metaphor
Life is a journey is a common metaphor.

proxy, substitute
He voted by proxy because he couldn't attend the meeting.

clothing
The store sells athletic apparel.

the use of an arbitrator to settle a dispute
The dispute was resolved through arbitration.

a group of items or people viewed as a whole
The musical ensemble performed beautifully.

The beginning of something, especially something unpleasant.
The onset of winter brought cold weather.

Hostility and ill-treatment, especially because of race or political or religious beliefs.
Many refugees fled their country due to political persecution.

Written or spoken language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure.
Her writing style was clear and concise prose.

The practice or occupation of engaging in sexual activity with someone for payment.
Prostitution is illegal in many countries.

The restoration of friendly relations.
After years of conflict, they finally achieved reconciliation.

The act of providing financial support for an event, activity, or person.
The event received generous sponsorship from local businesses.

the top or highest part
The climber reached the apex of the mountain.

a catastrophic event
Many movies depict a post-apocalypse world.

the action or process of combining a number of things into a single more effective or coherent whole
The company announced the consolidation of its two smaller offices into one large headquarters.

a compilation or summary of information
The magazine publishes a monthly digest of news.

the profession, activity, or skill of managing international relations
The conflict was resolved through careful diplomacy.

a state of depression or a style of music
He's been in a bit of a funk lately.

the action or process of inducting someone to a position or organization
The new employees went through an induction program.

a nerve cell
The brain is made up of billions of neurons.

the act of entering or passing through
The company achieved significant market penetration.

a layer of impurities; worthless people
There was a layer of green scum on the pond.

a proposition that can be proved
Pythagoras' theorem is fundamental in geometry.

an official in ancient Rome; a popular leader; a newspaper
The newspaper is called 'The Chicago Tribune'.

chronicle
The book is a chronicle of the events of the past century.

confederate
He was accused of being a confederate in the crime.

creed
The organization's creed emphasizes honesty and integrity.

dissertation
He spent a year writing his doctoral dissertation.
